name: Zscaler Inc
moat_justification: Zero Trust Exchange architecture with real enterprise switching costs (#1 ZTNA-as-a-service, #2 SASE; 785 customers >$1M ARR, ~115% net retention, telemetry scale) and working land-and-expand into data security / AI security / SecOps — against platformization and bundling by Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, Fortinet and Microsoft, no endpoint/firewall base, unproven pricing power (growth guided down to ~17%, RPO decelerating three straight quarters), and rising data-center capex intensity.
fragility_flags: DILUTION: share count growing 3.4%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025, 2026 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 0.19 vs 3-yr median 0.72 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
LOW_OE_YIELD: base OE yield 0.3% — valuation rests almost entirely on growth; tier is fragile
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.0x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: Category-defining zero-trust platform, moat 6/10 — but SBC is $821.9M against OCF of $1,129.7M, so normalized owner's earnings are $0.72/share (a 0.31% yield) against a $228.66 price; weighted IRR 3.26% with IV@15% of $11.14, it clears 15% only below ~$11 (~$8 with a margin of safety).
moat_for: Architectural switching costs — Zero Trust Exchange re-architecture to rip out; #1 ZTNA-as-a-service, #2 SASE
Scale and telemetry from the exchange's transaction volume feeding threat/data models
Installed-base compounding: 785 customers >$1M ARR (+18%), ~115% net retention
Land-and-expand into data security, Security-for-AI (+50% sequential bookings) and SecOps via Red Canary
moat_against: Platformization/bundling by Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, Fortinet, Microsoft Entra; peers' ARR momentum stronger
No endpoint, firewall base, or owned user surface — expensive enterprise sales motion
Pricing power unproven: growth guided down to ~17% for FY27, RPO decelerating three straight quarters
Rising infrastructure intensity — FY26 capex $277.3M building own data centers
